notes:

REF-BM-10: Tag entry fields are plain comma-separated text inputs with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-15: AND and OR plus quoted literal operators work, but NOT and parenthesised groups are explicitly unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation implementation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved views preserve search terms and included tags, but have no excluded-tag criteria.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import implementation exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export implementation exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings such as default sort, displayed-item count, or font size exist.
